chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, who said:

I wrote to him, peace be upon him, about a woman who became pure from her menstruation or from the blood of her postpartum bleeding at the beginning of a day in the Month of Ramadan, then experienced istihadha. So she performed salat and fasted the entire Month of Ramadan without doing what a mustahadah does of ghusl for every two prayers. Is her fasting and her salat valid or not?

So he, peace be upon him, wrote: “She must make up her fasting, and she does not make up her salat, because the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, used to command the believing women among his wives to do that.”

key_terms.اسْتُحِيضَتْ: she experienced istihadha, irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: ritual bath required in this context for validity of certain acts
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ: a woman in the state of istihadha
key_terms.تَقْضِي: she makes up or performs later what was missed or invalid
key_terms.طَهُرَتْ: became ritually pure from menstruation or postpartum bleeding

ai.seo_question: Does a woman in istihadha who omitted the required ghusl have to make up her fasts and prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who became pure from hayd or nifas and then entered a state of istihadha during Ramadan without performing the required ghusl for prayers. The Imam عليه السلام ruled that she must make up her fasts but not her prayers, grounding the ruling in the practice commanded by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "I wrote to Imam (as) about a woman who became pure from her menstruation or postpartum bleeding at the beginning of the day in the Month of Ramadan, but then experienced istihadha (irregular bleeding). She prayed and fasted the entire Month of Ramadan without performing the required ghusl for every two prayers as is prescribed for a woman in istihadha. Is her fasting and prayer valid or not?"

Imam (as) wrote in reply: "She must make up her fasts, but she does not need to make up her prayers, because the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) used to command the believing women among his wives to follow this ruling."
